entities.summary: Kayode Oyebode Adebowale FRSC is a Nigerian professor, scientist and the 13th vice-chancellor of the University of Ibadan. In October 2021, he became the vice-chancellor of the University of Ibadan, having formerly served as the deputy vice-chancellor (administration) of the University of Ibadan, and as the dean of the faculty of science in same institution.
